notes: Mobile Harness Code — independent fork of Mobile Harness. New: on-device document base (RAG) — save text documents in Settings → Document base and the Sidekick assistant retrieves the most relevant passages when answering (local keyword index, no embedding service or external call; Eco Mode-aware). Also adds multilingual voice input directly in the coding agent's chat input bar (Auto / Serbian / English / Swedish), alongside the existing Sidekick voice typing. Keeps the MCP client, local model (Ollama/llama.cpp) fallback, AI router fallback chain, Material 3 dynamic color, in-app update, Telegram bot, multimodal Sidekick, Eco Mode (Token Saver), Developer Tools, session auto-recovery, release & signing, optional server sync, reproducible build + SBOM. This APK is SIGNED (V1+V2+V3); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
